_readme: Every photo slot on the site. To replace a placeholder, save the photo at the path in 'desktop.file' (and 'mobile.file' if listed) inside assets/images/, then rebuild. 'focal' is the CSS object-position for that crop. Leave 'alt' empty only when 'decorative' is true. PHOTO-GUIDE.md explains each slot in detail.
